svg.title: Abdelhmeed Elshorbagy: Server Administrator at Amwag Travel
svg.desc: Mobile layout of the decapped U1 chip etched with Abdelhmeed Elshorbagy, and its pin assignment: Server Administrator at Amwag Travel; IT Help Desk; Computer Science & AI student, Minya National University; Minya, Egypt; Bilingual product builder (Arabic / English); Cybersecurity enthusiast; Founder of DÖSE, an Egyptian niche fragrance house; On GitHub since 2020.
